findings: Browser profile checkpoints can succeed without any game character-save file.
An empty folder selected for an optional export is not the automatic save location.
Existing game-origin profile snapshots were copied and CRC-validated read-only; no game save was overwritten.
changes: Badge distinguishes profile-only storage, stored character files, and file-read attempts.
Automatic save/load remains the default; backups are explicitly optional.
Bounded local queue-save and cloud-file diagnostics survive unrelated log noise.
